card.name: End of cynomolgus and similar words
card.fires_on: The last piece of the word cynomolgus (the 'us' before 'monkeys') in animal pregnancy study text. It also fires on a mid-word piece in Lao script and on the end of a drug name such as donepezil.

modes.label: Cynomolgus monkeys
modes.description: The ending 'us' of cynomolgus, just before 'monkeys', in animal reproduction study statements.
modes.example: administration of pertuzumab to pregnant cynomolg<<us>> monkeys during the period of organogenesis resulted

modes.label: Lao script
modes.description: A Lao letter inside a word in Lao-language text, such as a motto.
modes.example: ສັນຕິພາບ ເອ<<ກ>>ະລາດ ປະ

modes.label: Drug name ending
modes.description: The closing piece of a drug name such as donepezil.
